description: Parkings is a dataset listed in GPSO - Grand Paris Seine Ouest - OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des parkings sur le Territoire de Grand Paris Seine Ouest Le modèle du jeu de données a été modifié en 2020 pour s'intégrer pleinement à la plateforme nationale Les noms de champs en minuscule reprennent la nomenclature du modèle national Les noms de champs en majuscule sont spécifiques au modèle de données GPSO Retrouvez ... Coverage: Grand Paris Seine Ouest. The portal files it under Stationnement, Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are Parkings, Boulogne-Billancourt, Chaville, Issy-Les-Moulineaux, Meudon, Sèvres. The portal shows 51 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seineouest-fr-portal.
